provenance: All FOUR channels read LIVE from Chrome (macOS, local browser) on 2026-09-10. Facebook and Instagram read from Meta Business Suite Insights; the Meta window rolled ONE day forward to 12 Aug - 8 Sep 2026 (the previous cycle covered 11 Aug - 7 Sep). All four Facebook 28-day series reconcile exactly to their KPIs: views 3788, visits 312, interactions 149, video 3s 160. The Facebook views KPI renders as the rounded '3,8K', so the exact figure 3788 is taken from the 28-day series and is consistent with the previous read (3951 - 422 for 11 Aug + 259 for 8 Sep = 3788). Instagram views (1211) and interactions (49) also sum exactly, and views split 630 from followers + 581 from non-followers = 1211; Instagram reach is de-duplicated per person over the window so its daily series (286) does not sum to the 195 KPI, which is expected, and reach splits 19 followers + 176 non-followers = 195 exactly. Direction of every Meta change percentage was decoded from the rendered colour of the trend label (green rgb(0,107,78) = increase, red rgb(162,12,23) = decrease) because the text layer carries no sign. Total Facebook followers (116, up from 115 after more than two weeks flat) and Instagram followers (48) read at business.facebook.com/latest/; Instagram post count (121) and following (36) read at instagram.com/dxliving.au. IMPORTANT METRIC NOTE: the Facebook per-post figure carried in the dashboard series is the number shown in the Business Suite Insights recent-content panel, which is VIEWS, not reach - this is kept for continuity with every prior snapshot. The Business Suite published-posts content table was NOT re-opened this cycle, so facebook.post_true_reach is CARRIED unchanged from the 2026-09-03 read and is flagged carried:true. Instagram per-post figures are true reach, read from the Instagram Insights recent-content panel. YouTube Studio read live for Aug 12 - Sep 8, 2026, matching the Meta window exactly: views 288 (up from 61) and watch time 0.2 hrs (90% less than the previous 28 days). The jump is entirely the 8 Sep Short, which has now entered the window at 269 views. Studio again showed a typical-performance comparison for Views ('188 more than usual') rather than a prior-period percentage, so views_prior and the views change percentage are null rather than derived. The top-content table has TEN rows summing to 286 against the 288 channel total; Studio also displayed a banner saying view counting was updated and recent counts may be higher, which is the most likely source of the 2-view gap, so no figure was adjusted. Subscribers (4) read from the Studio dashboard; the library split (15 long-form + 15 Shorts = 30) read from the Studio content tabs (1-15 of 15 on each). A NEW SHORT, 'DX Living | The Process Behind the Finish - Project 251', was published on 9 Sep 2026 and is OUTSIDE the 28-day window that ends 8 Sep; the Studio dashboard reported 112 views, 37.1% average percentage viewed and 1 like in its first 17 hours 19 minutes, and the realtime panel showed 387 views in the last 48 hours. LinkedIn Content, Followers and Visitors admin pages all read live and LinkedIn's window advanced TWO days to 10 Aug - 8 Sep 2026. Every LinkedIn trend direction was decoded from the DOM class (analytics-tools-shared-trend-text__value--increase-caret-lead / --decrease-caret-lead / --neutral-caret-lead) and its aria-label, not inferred. impressions_prior (1677) is DERIVED from the displayed decrease of 26.9%, not read directly. LinkedIn total followers rose to 101. Facebook link_clicks remains carried from the 2026-08-07 snapshot. No estimated values. No Supermetrics.

vi: Cả bốn kênh đọc trực tiếp qua Chrome ngày 10/9. Cửa sổ Meta và YouTube trượt một ngày sang 12/8 – 8/9; cửa sổ LinkedIn nhích hai ngày sang 10/8 – 8/9.

TIN LỚN NHẤT: bài Facebook 9/9 về bề mặt bê tông trang trí Concreet của Project 251 mở hàng 173 view, 4 cảm xúc và 1 chia sẻ ngay tối đầu tiên — mở hàng mạnh nhất từ trước tới nay, gấp gần mười lần bài 8/9 (18 view). Story đăng sau đó hai phút cũng lấy 28 view và 3 cảm xúc, cao hơn mọi story từng ghi nhận.
Views Facebook 3.951 → 3.788 (▼28,8%, từ ▼20,9%). Ngày 11/8 (422 view — ngày cao nhất của cửa sổ cũ) rơi ra, ngày 8/9 (259 view) vào. Đây là hiệu ứng cửa sổ, không phải bài mới yếu.
Lượt truy cập Facebook 284 → 312 và phép so lật từ ▼5,0% sang ▲6,1% — ngày 8/9 đóng góp 30 lượt. Đây là dòng Facebook duy nhất tăng ngoài video.

Video 3 giây 154 → 160 (▲13,5%) nhờ ngày 8/9 đóng góp 30 view, nhưng thời gian xem 52 phút 41 giây → 52 phút 27 giây và lật mạnh sang ▼17,7%. Người xem 420 → 342 (▼36,1%) và tương tác 157 → 149 (▼19,9%).
Cả bốn chuỗi 28 ngày Facebook khớp đúng KPI: 3.788 / 312 / 149 / 160. Tương tác từ follower 95 (▼25,8%) so với 54 từ người chưa follow (▼6,9%).
Follower Trang Facebook CUỐI CÙNG ĐÃ TĂNG: 115 → 116, lần đầu sau hơn hai tuần đứng yên. Bộ đếm follower ròng trong cửa sổ vẫn 0 vì lần tăng rơi vào ngày 9/9.
Mọi bài Facebook cũ đều chín thêm: 8/9 từ 18 → 43, 7/9 từ 39 → 57, 6/9 từ 51 → 69, 4/9 từ 54 → 72, 3/9 từ 66 → 75. Bài 2/9 (346 view) và 1/9 đã trôi khỏi bảng nội dung gần đây.
Số bài Instagram 120 → 121 với bài Concreet 9/9: mở hàng 11 reach, 4 like và 1 chia sẻ — reach mở hàng cao nhất chuỗi này và lên thẳng đầu bảng. Follower giữ 48 kỳ thứ ba.

Views Instagram 1.205 → 1.211 (▲19,7%) nhưng reach rơi mạnh 273 → 195 (▼28,3%) và tương tác 55 → 49 (▼33,8%), do ngày 11/8 (107 view, 87 reach) rơi ra. Views (1.211) và tương tác (49) cộng khớp chính xác; reach cũng khớp: 19 follower + 176 chưa follow.
Cơ cấu nguồn views Instagram ĐẢO CHIỀU: 61,4% từ follower (630) so với 38,6% từ người chưa follow (581), lật ngược tỷ lệ 54,7/45,3 hôm qua. Reach thì vẫn 90% đến từ khám phá.

YOUTUBE BÙNG NỔ: Short 8/9 đã vào cửa sổ và kéo views 61 → 288 (gấp 4,7 lần). Riêng Short đó 269 view với 71,2% tỷ lệ xem trung bình — chiếm 93% toàn bộ view của kênh trong 28 ngày. Watch time 0,1 → 0,2 giờ, mức giảm dịu từ ▼97% xuống ▼90%.
Nhưng 269 view KHÔNG mang về người đăng ký nào — vẫn đúng 4. Đây là lỗ hổng CTA rõ ràng nhất trong toàn bộ báo cáo.

Short thứ hai lên ngày 9/9, 'The Process Behind the Finish - Project 251', đạt 112 view và 37,1% tỷ lệ xem sau 17 giờ 19 phút — yếu hơn hẳn Short 8/9 (269 view, 71,2%) cả về lượng lẫn giữ chân. Kho video 29 → 30 (15 dài + 15 Shorts).
LinkedIn follower 100 → 101. Vẫn 43 follower mới trong 30 ngày (▲437,5%). Metro Manila 2 → 3 — thay đổi đầu tiên ở đếm theo thành phố sau mười kỳ; hai follower mới không rơi vào Úc.
Impressions LinkedIn 1.221 → 1.226 và phép so kỳ trước tiếp tục bớt xấu ▼27,3% → ▼26,9%, kỳ cải thiện thứ hai liên tiếp. Reactions 85 → 87 (▲35,9%). Comment vẫn bằng 0 ở mọi kỳ.

Bảng khách truy cập LinkedIn lùi nhẹ: lượt xem trang 113 → 112, khách duy nhất 43 → 42, máy tính 74 / điện thoại 38 (66% desktop). Quản lý chương trình & dự án hạ 4 → 3 nhưng vẫn trong bảng kỳ thứ tư; Mua hàng và Tư vấn rơi khỏi bảng, Nhân sự và Pháp lý vào.
en: All four channels read live via Chrome on 10 Sep. The Meta and YouTube windows rolled one day forward to 12 Aug – 8 Sep; the LinkedIn window advanced two days to 10 Aug – 8 Sep.

THE HEADLINE: the 9 Sep Facebook post on Project 251's Concreet decorative concrete surface opened at 173 views, 4 reactions and 1 share on its first evening — the strongest opener in this entire series, nearly ten times the 8 Sep post's 18. A story published two minutes later took 28 views and 3 reactions, itself higher than any story recorded here.
Facebook views 3,951 → 3,788 (▼28.8%, from ▼20.9%). 11 Aug (422 views, the highest day of the old window) dropped out and 8 Sep (259 views) came in. This is a window effect, not a weak new post.
Facebook visits 284 → 312 and the comparison flipped from ▼5.0% to ▲6.1% — 8 Sep contributed 30 visits. Apart from video, this is the only Facebook line up on the prior period.
Video 3-second views 154 → 160 (▲13.5%) on 30 views from 8 Sep, but watch time slipped 52m 41s → 52m 27s and swung hard to ▼17.7%. Viewers 420 → 342 (▼36.1%) and interactions 157 → 149 (▼19.9%).
All four Facebook 28-day series reconcile exactly to their KPIs: 3,788 / 312 / 149 / 160. Interactions from followers 95 (▼25.8%) against 54 from non-followers (▼6.9%).
Facebook page followers FINALLY MOVED: 115 → 116, the first gain in over two weeks. The in-window net-new counter still reads 0 because the gain lands on 9 Sep.

Every existing Facebook post kept maturing: 8 Sep 18 → 43, 7 Sep 39 → 57, 6 Sep 51 → 69, 4 Sep 54 → 72, 3 Sep 66 → 75. The 2 Sep post (346 views) and the 1 Sep post have both scrolled off the recent-content panel.

Instagram post count 120 → 121 with the 9 Sep Concreet cross-post: 11 reach, 4 likes and 1 share on opening — the highest first-evening reach in this series and straight to the top of the panel. Followers held at 48 for a third read.

Instagram views 1,205 → 1,211 (▲19.7%) but reach fell hard, 273 → 195 (▼28.3%), and interactions 55 → 49 (▼33.8%), as 11 Aug (107 views, 87 reach) dropped out. Views (1,211) and interactions (49) reconcile exactly; so does reach, 19 from followers + 176 from non-followers.
The Instagram view mix REVERSED: 61.4% from followers (630) against 38.6% from non-followers (581), flipping yesterday's 54.7/45.3. Reach is still 90% discovery.

YOUTUBE BROKE OUT: the 8 Sep Short entered the window and dragged views 61 → 288, a 4.7x jump. That Short alone carries 269 views at 71.2% average percentage viewed — 93% of everything the channel earned in 28 days. Watch time 0.1 → 0.2 hrs and the decline eased from ▼97% to ▼90%.
But 269 views produced ZERO new subscribers — still exactly 4. That is the clearest CTA gap anywhere in this report.

A second Short went up on 9 Sep, 'The Process Behind the Finish - Project 251', at 112 views and 37.1% average viewed after 17 hours 19 minutes — materially weaker than the 8 Sep Short (269 views, 71.2%) on both volume and retention. Library 29 → 30 (15 long-form + 15 Shorts).
LinkedIn followers 100 → 101. Still 43 new followers in 30 days (▲437.5%). Metro Manila 2 → 3 is the first change in any city count in ten reads; neither new follower landed in Australia.
LinkedIn impressions 1,221 → 1,226 and the prior-period comparison eased again, ▼27.3% → ▼26.9%, a second consecutive improvement. Reactions 85 → 87 (▲35.9%). Comments remain zero in every cycle.

The LinkedIn visitor panel edged back: page views 113 → 112, unique visitors 43 → 42, 74 desktop / 38 mobile (66% desktop). Program and Project Management eased 4 → 3 but held in the table for a fourth read; Purchasing and Consulting dropped out while Human Resources and Legal entered.
